The overall objective of the programme is to contribute to a reduction in poverty of
30 per cent by 2030 and to improve living conditions for rural people in mountain
zones. The specific objective is to strengthen the capacities of target populations in
order to improve their incomes and resilience to the effects of climate change, by
developing value chains based on sustainable natural resource use and
